Pool Stage:
Two pools of four teams. Each team plays three matches against the other teams in its pool.

Quarter-finals:
The top two teams from each pool qualify. Pool A winner plays Pool B runner-up and vice versa.

Semi-finals:
Quarter-final winners progress to two semi-finals.

Final:
The two semi-final winners play for the championship at Eden Park, Auckland.
